knobs.note: BH-6458: 1 lets the lane push impact-learn/edges and open the learned-edge PR; 0 is dry: it reads, learns in the worktree, prints would-open, and pushes and marks nothing. Read by bin/impact-learn-lane.sh as ${IMPACT_LEARN_ACT:-1}.
BH-6458: hours of dequeue_events the lane reads per tick; also the age at which a state/impact-learn/seen.tsv line is pruned. Read by bin/impact-learn-lane.sh as ${IMPACT_LEARN_WINDOW_H:-168}.
BH-6458: the most candidate rows learned per tick, oldest first; the rest wait for the next tick. Read by bin/impact-learn-lane.sh as ${IMPACT_LEARN_MAX_EVENTS:-50}.

BH-6458: more new edges than this in one tick opens no PR, marks nothing and pages impact-learn-mass once (a wide failure or a classifier fault; a person looks first). Read by bin/impact-learn-lane.sh as ${IMPACT_LEARN_MAX_EDGES:-30}.
BH-6458: passed to bin/impact-learn.sh record --max-paths, the most changed paths one suite may learn from one event. Read by bin/impact-learn-lane.sh as ${IMPACT_LEARN_MAX_PATHS:-10}.
BH-6458: an open lane PR older than this pages impact-learn-stale:<n>; while it is open the lane learns nothing. Read by bin/impact-learn-lane.sh as ${IMPACT_LEARN_PR_STALE_H:-48}.
Test seam: the epoch second bin/impact-learn-lane.sh uses as now (tests/impact-learn-lane.bh-6458-test.sh). Empty means the clock. NOT settable from the control plane.

Test seam gate: bin/impact-learn-lane.sh sources IMPACT_LEARN_LANE_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
